overview_description.description:
iSagha is the leading company in digitizing and modernize the precious metal trading and jewelry market in the middle east by utilizing affordable practical and evolutionary methods fitted to local markets and regulations. 
We aim to digitize and flourish the Middle east jewelry and precious metal investment markets by providing jewelers/investors with an online platform and tools to sell/buy products to large number of targeted buyers.
